This '''moon''' was the second of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] visited a a [[Unidentified Telerath moon base|spicer base]] there and freed many [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang]].
